Capability Contracts — Core Rules
Version: 1.0

Shared capability: independently consumable stable contract where practical.
Provider/adapter: implementation of a capability for platform/external system.
Connection/instance: configured account/device/install/provider instance.
Node: durable EDEN device/system identity; not IP/hostname/service.
Representation: one available form/location/interface of an identity/object/capability.
Authoritative owner: owns domain semantics/intent.
BIFROST may discover/register/permission/relate without becoming mandatory gateway.
Experimental bridge: temporary implementation permitted for bootstrap/testing; never establishes ownership.
